# Synthetic manuscript fixture (declared E-value check, --evalues)

## Results

Exposure was associated with the outcome (RR 1.52; 95% CI 1.20 to 1.93). The E-value
was 2.42 for the point estimate and 1.70 for the lower confidence limit.

In the secondary analysis the association was weaker (RR 1.30; 95% CI 0.95 to 1.78), with
an E-value of 1.92 (1.00 for the confidence limit).

Statin use was protective (RR 0.70; 95% CI 0.55 to 0.89); E-values 2.21 and 1.50.

The E-value for the primary association (HR 1.52) was 2.41.
